propositions: Documentation falsely claims bug tickets are gate-exempt with runner=exempt, when code shows bugs receive light advisory review under bug tier and always pass but are never exempt.
review_plan docstring incorrectly states bugs are exempt; it should document the bug review tier behavior instead.
docs/plan-review-gate.md does not correctly name session_log, code_review, and identity as the only gate-exempt types.
Claim-time CLI exemption for bugs (no signed attestation required) is conflated with gate-time review exemption; these are separate axes and must be documented distinctly.
workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck only short-circuits session_log, code_review, and identity; bug review tier exemption was deliberately removed in epic 6982.
